current_behavior:
IDENTITY. On the website/app/admin the endpoint never reads identity from the message: api/ai-chat.php:51 `$ctx = AiTools::whoIsWeb();` → includes/aitools.php:237-290. It checks `Auth::admin()` (ADMIN_SESSION_KEY, includes/auth.php:790) first: roles agent/counter → role 'staff' with `scopeAdminId` = their id; manager/superadmin → 'admin'; any other admin role (support, scanner…) keeps customer tools (aitools.php:258-269). Then `Auth::user()` (USER_SESSION_KEY, auth.php:1263) → 'customer' with `phone` from the OTP session; otherwise a guest keyed by a hashed PHP session id (aitools.php:286-287). Admin pages and the SPA share one session cookie (includes/bootstrap.php:169), so admin/ai-copilot.php and the floating widget hit the same endpoint with the same identity. The JS `roleOf()` (assets/js/16-lazy.js:2305) is cosmetic. On WhatsApp the Twilio-signed sender number (api/whatsapp-webhook.php:114-143) is resolved by `AiTools::whoIs` (aitools.php:105-210) against `admins.phone` (or a WaLogin session when wa_login_on). A phone typed in chat is only ever a tool argument for staff (my_tickets/office_customer); ownership is re-checked in `mayRead` (aitools.php:3147-3160).

PROVIDERS. `AiAgent::webEnabled` (includes/aiagent.php:103-108) = ai_web_agent_on AND (anthropic OR gemini key); `enabled()` for WhatsApp (89-95) = wa_agent_on AND any of five keys. `buildLadder` (516-535) with ai_model_ladder='auto' tries cerebras → grok → gemini → openrouter → anthropic (cheap first); `ask()` (470-505) steps to the next brain on any null; Gemini has its own 3.8→3.5-flash ladder with one 503 retry and no 429 retry (701-852). When every brain fails `AiTurn::run` returns null and api/ai-chat.php:71 answers 502 "busy"; with no key at all it answers 503 (ai-chat.php:45-49). Live evidence: SHG_BOOT shows `"ai":false,"aiAgent":true` (no Anthropic key, agent on with another key); a guest probe "Rajkot bata bus kati baje chha?" returned HTTP 502, "mero commission kati bhayo?" returned a correct polite refusal. Three other brains exist: the toolless `AiChat` (includes/aichat.php:43-74, gemini-first, WhatsApp only), the Anthropic-only api/ai-proxy.php (dead on live), and the rule engine `answerIntent` in 16-lazy.js:2136-2163.

RULE-BASED FALLBACK / "I WILL BOOK A TICKET". There is no literal phrase; the collapse comes from four places. (a) WhatsApp with the model unavailable: includes/wabot.php:378-408 calls `TicketBrain::capture`, which makes a draft whenever the parser found seats/date/direction/boarding (ticketbrain.php:936-939) or any word of a broad list ('want','need','jana','milcha','khali'… ticketbrain.php:1066-1074) and replies "तपाईंको अनुरोध प्राप्त भयो… डेस्कले बस, सिट र भाडा पक्का गरेर तपाईंको टिकट यहीँ छिट्टै पठाउनेछ" (wabot.php:401-407). (b) `WaBooking::looksLikeRequest` (wabooking.php:1036-1083) runs BEFORE the model (wa_local_first=1, wabot.php:283-288) and opens a sale on any booking word that is not phrased as a question. (c) The toolless prompt rule 4 (aichat.php:155-157): "tell the passenger what to send (date, how many seats, boarding point) and say the desk confirms it". (d) The agent's customer briefing when selling is off (aiagent.php:1634-1637): "use plan_ticket to tell them the bus and the fare, and say our desk will confirm the seat and send the ticket here shortly", plus the base STYLE rule to end every answer with a 👉 Book line (aiprompt.php:119). On the website the rule engine's 'book' intent (16-lazy.js:1790) is substring-matched (2159) so "seat number galat cha" gets "Booking is easy…".

INTENT COVERAGE. No classifier exists; the model picks from the role/switch-filtered catalogue (aitools.php:325-703). Present as tools: booking status (find_ticket, my_tickets), quote (plan_ticket — which also STAGES a sale, 971-983), cancel/refund (refund_quote, cancel_ticket), changes (rename_passenger; quote_ticket_fix/fix_ticket for date/phone only; pickup/berth/bus → "desk"), commission/wallet (my_wallet, agent_day, my_sales, request_payout; office_agent/office_agents), ops (office_day/alerts, sales_report, occupancy_report, site_visitors, agent_leaderboard; office_confirm/settle_cod/reject/agent_status behind wa_agent_admin_write=0), KB (ai_kb_on=0), handoff/docs/step-up (wa_ops_* all 0). Route enquiry has no tool: it relies on the prompt facts built from routes/route_stops (aiprompt.php:38-61) and on bus_eta. Three further keyword vocabularies route intents before the model on WhatsApp (wabooking.php:1051-1140, ticketbrain.php:1066-1074, wafaq.php) and one in JS — none shared.

TOOLS/CONFIRMATION/AUDIT. Gate order in `AiTools::run` (aitools.php:752-773): catalogue membership (role + switch), AiVerify step-up (off by default), then the tool. Writes: issue_ticket, staff_sell, bulk_issue, cancel_ticket, rename_passenger, fix_ticket, request_payout, office_confirm, office_settle_cod, office_reject, office_agent_status, marketing_*, handoff_to_staff, record_feedback, company_doc_send. Consent enforcement is uneven: fix_ticket needs confirm:true AND a bare yes in the person's message AND a row-locked next-turn stage (1574-1597); payout/settle/reject/agent_status need `saidYes` (2407, 2780, 2828, 2888); issue_ticket/staff_sell/cancel_ticket need only the model's confirm flag plus a next-turn staged quote (1216-1237, 1273-1324, 1384-1391); office_confirm needs only the model flag and role admin — no staging at all (2170-2192). Every call lands in ai_agent_calls (3282-3316) and admin/ai-activity.php lists it. Runtime-verified bug (local DB, reflection probe): on the web channel the quote is staged under `stageKey` ('web-staff-N', 3199/3202) but `takeStage` clears by phone (3257), so the quote survives the sale and a later "ho" can press staff_sell/issue_ticket again within 15 minutes; QuickTicket::sell has no repeat guard (customer path only, quickticket.php:893/1066).

DIAGNOSTICS. Provider failures go to Logger ('AI agent HTTP …', channel 'whatsapp', aiagent.php:1156-1161; 'brain unavailable' 501; 'Web agent failed' 185) → logs/<date>.log and app_logs (includes/logger.php:88-101). No admin page reads app_logs (only admin/api/schedule-action.php), admin/health.php and cron/alerts.php have no AI check; ai-activity.php shows tool rows only, so a dead brain looks like "no activity". The widget swallows the 502 silently (16-lazy.js:2497-2508); the copilot shows "⚠️ The assistant is busy" (ai-copilot.php:238). AiGovernor (includes/aigovernor.php) is an allow-list for learning-job settings writes and is required by nothing but tests/governor-spine-test.php:30. includes/ai/* is a dead gen-2 scaffold and ai_manager_* settings/tables are orphaned. cron/ai-warm.php does not exist (could not verify any AI cron).

gaps.proposed_change: Add includes/aiintent.php `AiIntent::classify(string $text, array $ctx): array{intent,confidence,slots}` — one deterministic table that absorbs the four keyword vocabularies (wabooking.php:1051-1140, ticketbrain.php:1066-1074, wafaq.php FARE/TIME/…, 16-lazy.js INTENTS/TIME_WORDS/HUMAN_WORDS) with intents greet, route_enquiry, fare, availability, book_new, booking_status, ticket_change, cancel_refund, payment, commission_wallet, ops_report, ops_action, complaint_handoff, company_info, smalltalk, other. In AiAgent::converse pass `$ctx['intent']` into systemPrompt (one INTENT line + the matching playbook paragraph) and into AiTools::catalogue to restrict the tool list by an intent→tools map (route_enquiry never sees plan_ticket/issue_ticket). In wabot.php:378-408 only call TicketBrain::capture when intent===book_new with confidence ≥ 0.7; otherwise answer route/fare via WaFaq (make wa_faq_on default 1) or the menu. gaps.test: New tests/ai-intent-test.php (offline table: 40 real messages → intent); extend tests/wa-local-booking-test.php with 'Rajkot bata bus kati baje chha?' → no draft, timing answer.
